controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by TOI-1231; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of TOI-1231 b is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of toi-1231's light, as its colour dataset measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of TOI-1231's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1231 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

TOI-1231 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (63, 90, 99) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 447061717, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 21 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.

physical.credit: Radius from Burt et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162...87B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Burt et al. 2021, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2021AJ....162...87B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Burt et al. 2021 (2021AJ....162...87B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
